messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD Alert fired: service=keystone-gateway threshold=5xx-rate spike (512r/min). Pager: PagerDuty #2387.

pagerduty: Pager duty notification: Incident INC-2026-2387 created and routed to @ben_oncall.

ben_oncall: On-call here, acked the page. Looking at dashboards.

ben_oncall: Initial check: spikes started ~2m ago, error rate ~18% for /v1/generate upstream 502/503.

cara_sre: Thanks. Any region specificity?

dan_engineer: eu-west-1 mostly, small blips in us-west. Adding link to graph: https://grafana.redwood/shot/keystone-5xx?from=now-10m

ben_oncall: stack traces show backend kv-proxy returning 502 on high concurrency. Posting sample logs:

ben_oncall: ```
[2026-07-12T03:14:05Z] request_id=abc123 upstream=kv-proxy-12 status=502 err=backend_eof
[2026-07-12T03:14:06Z] request_id=abc124 upstream=kv-proxy-15 status=502 err=read_timeout
```

cara_sre: Runbook step 1: if kv-proxy saturation, reduce incoming qps via traffic-slice or route to fallback model variant. Any quick toggle?

dan_engineer: We have a traffic-slice config for keystone: run `rctl route set keystone fallback=true slice=lowlatency` but that needs approval.

ben_oncall: I'm going to flip a throttling rule to cut non-paying traffic by 40% to protect SLOs. Will post command.

ben_oncall: ```sh
# reduce anonymous quota
redctl quota update --service keystone --profile anonymous --scale 0.6
```

ben_oncall: Done. Watch dashboards.

dan_engineer: Error rate dropped to ~9% after throttle, latency stabilized. Still seeing occasional 502s from kv-proxy-15.

cara_sre: Good. Start mitigation 2: spin a replacement kv-proxy pod on eu-west-1 with newer connection limits. Dan, can you kick a deploy?

dan_engineer: Kicking a canary deploy now (rolling restart kv-proxy). `k rollout restart deployment/kv-proxy -n keystone --max-unavailable=1`

maya_support: FYI support team notified customers on impacted routes (sent brief at 03:20).

ben_oncall: Canary restarted, new pods healthy. 5xx down to ~2.2%. Leaving this thread for watch. If it creeps >5% re-open pager.

cara_sre: Agreed. Ben, if you need to hand off, please ping night team before 03:45 UTC.

ben_oncall: Will hand off if stable at 03:40. Marking incident as mitigated but monitoring. :white_check_mark:
